facts.value: Test-optional for Fall 2027: choose review with or without scores. Scores meeting traditional requirements give automatic admission; test-optional files get holistic committee review (transcript, resume/activities, one short essay). Homeschooled and non-accredited-school applicants must submit ACT/SAT. Superscores both
Not required; Mizzou asks for the FAFSA (priority deadline Feb 1)

Yes: complete application by Dec 1 for merit consideration. Fall 2027 Missouri residents: $3,500-$11,000/yr (Mizzou Scholars $11,000); non-residents: Mark Twain Level 1 $21,500/yr or Level 2 $8,500/yr, +$3,000 Border State Award; full tuition for National Merit finalists/semifinalists

2026-27 billed costs: Missouri resident $31,942-$36,070; non-resident $55,104-$59,232 (tuition/fees by major $16,162-$20,290 vs $39,324-$43,452; housing/dining $15,780). Books and personal costs extra
Rolling admission: decisions from Oct 1; Dec 1 priority date for merit scholarships; final application deadline July 1. No ED or EA
Honors College has its own application (scholarships deadline Dec 1); official test scores and transcript must be on file. Tuition varies by major
No supplemental essays for applicants submitting test scores; test-optional applicants answer one short essay question in the application
